evidence_status: exploratory because member selection uses previously observed train_explore OOF results
hypothesis: stable rank fusion across three previously zero-harm rankers yields a more robust and broader C100 slot-10 proposal surface than either the current or pairwise ranker alone
unique_variable: replace the supplemental proposal with fixed equal-weight RRF-3 while retaining the current 0.9715 policy as immutable default

fusion.rank_definition: stable one-based descending rank with lower candidate index winning equal-score ties

supplemental_action.current_served_choice: current ranker choice when frozen admission activates, otherwise P11 incumbent
supplemental_action.available_when: RRF-3 choice differs from current served choice and differs from P11 incumbent
supplemental_action.keep: bit-exact current chosen and activation arrays

admission.model: two C=0.2 liblinear logistic heads with weighted preprocessing
admission.inner_safety: aggregate and every inner fold have zero hit-to-miss, nonnegative MRR delta, and nonpositive MTTC delta relative current

cross_fit.ranker_surfaces: each member is outer-fold OOF; fusion is fixed and target-blind
cross_fit.admission_outer_inner: five outer product-family folds with five fixed inner folds and outer-train quantile mapping
cross_fit.claim: nested admission over frozen outer-OOF ranker surfaces, not end-to-end nested stacking

oracle_and_stop_rule.if_no_promotion: close RRF-3 without member, k, weight, feature, multiplier, or threshold tuning and proceed to preregistered focused nonlinear LambdaMART
oracle_and_stop_rule.if_promotion: do not deploy directly; preregister full-member export, parity, distillation decision, and target-free resource benchmark
